description: A ground-level photograph depicting a landscape identified in the accompanying text as Dry Mediterranean grasslands in Extremadura. The foreground consists of a relatively flat expanse of vibrant green grassland, punctuated by numerous scattered clumps of taller, brownish-green tussock vegetation. Beyond this, a horizontal band of denser, somewhat taller vegetation extends across the midground, suggesting a potential shift in moisture or vegetation type. In the background, a dense coniferous forest covers gently rolling hills under an overcast sky.
